blocks_element.repere: Paragraphe · LHLA Glitter jars have a shelf life of…
blocks_element.text:
LHLA Glitter jars have a shelf life of 18-24 months once opened but can last much longer if properly cared for.

• Keep plastic sealing disc inside (pro jars only) and do not leave jar open and exposed to air for long periods of time.
• Clean glass rim to keep it free from glitter build up as that may prevent jar from properly sealing.
• Mist or add a few drops of distilled water after every few uses.
• If glitter has lost it's adhesiveness due to drying out, add small amounts of distilled water and our Lemon.aid Mixing Medium to revive it.
